title: Marketplace privacy clauses and localized copy runbook
content:
PURPOSE
This is a lightweight playbook for packaging privacy-language, regulatory-ready snippets, and localized microcopy for cloud marketplace listings (AWS/GCP/Azure + regional stores). Goal: reduce legal back-and-forth at listing time, provide a short checklist for Product and GTM to validate before submission, and give marketing engineers quick copy variants to A/B test.

SCOPE + AUDIENCE
- Audience: GTM listing owners, partner managers, legal intake, engineering owners for Private/Dedicated runtimes.
- Scope: marketplace tiles and listing metadata (description, short blurb, hero microcopy), security/privacy short form (tile-level), trial entitlements, and localized translations for EU/UK/CA/APAC. Not a replacement for full DPA or enterprise contract.

QUICK RULES (one-liners for PMs)
- Always include a 1–2 sentence privacy note on the tile if customer data may be transmitted to Redwood-managed infrastructure.
- For Private/VPC options: emphasize customer-managed keys and data residency — use the Private-ready snippet.
- For Hosted API only (no dedicated/private): use explicit "hosted" language and link to DPA page.
- Provide localized variants for target markets: en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, ja-JP, ko-KR, and en-AU.

TEMPLATES: PRIVACY / SECURITY SNIPPETS (short form for marketplace tile)
1) Hosted (default) short tile line (EN):
   "Redwood Inference processes API requests to deliver model outputs; customer inputs may be logged for service quality. See our DPA and data retention policy for details."

2) Dedicated / Private (tile):
   "Available as Dedicated or Private deployments with configurable data residency and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM support). Logs and telemetry retention controlled by customer settings."

3) EU Data Residency emphasis (tile):
   "EU-region hosting available; European customer data stays within selected region under our EU Data Processing Agreement."

4) Trial entitlements (tile microcopy):
   "14-day trial, limited tokens; no production SLA until Dedicated contract is signed. Contact sales for private deployments and custom SLAs."

LOCALIZED COPY EXAMPLES (short phrase variants to drop into marketplace fields)
- en-US hero: "High-performance LLM inference with predictable latency and cost."
- en-GB hero: "Optimised LLM inference — reliable performance, local deployment options."
- fr-FR hero: "Inference LLM haute performance, options d'hébergement local et SLA."
- de-DE hero: "Skalierbare LLM-Inferenz mit Vorhersagbarer Latenz und Kostenkontrolle."
- ja-JP hero: "低レイテンシでコスト効率の高い LLM 推論。専用・プライベート環境にも対応。"
- ko-KR hero: "예측 가능한 지연 시간과 비용의 고성능 LLM 추론."

MICROCOPY EXPERIMENTS (CTA + trial phrasing)
- CTA A: "Start free trial" / subtext: "14 days, no card required"
- CTA B: "Try in your region" / subtext: "Select region for compliance-ready tests"
- CTA C: "Request Private demo" / subtext: "On-prem & VPC options available"
Notes: test CTA B for EU listings and CTA C for enterprise-targeted tiles.

LISTING ACCEPTANCE CHECKLIST (pre-submit)
- Listing metadata: title <= 80 chars, one-line short description (<=140 chars), long description (<=4000 chars).
- Privacy snippet present and correct for deployment modes offered.
- Trial entitlement copy included and consistent with pricing/legal.
- Billing SKU mapped (internal SKU + marketplace SKU) and listed in attachments.
- Security artifacts: link to SOC2 summary, DPA, and support contact. If Private/Dedicated supported, include short section on KMS/HSM and network topology options.
- Images: hero screenshot with locale-specific UI if UI shown; privacy/security badge image (if used) must be non-misleading.
- Legal sign-off: need one of Legal or Privacy engineering to sign-off for regions with strong data laws (EU/UK/CA/AU/JP).

REGULATORY / PRIVACY CLAUSE LIBRARY (short forms for legal intake)
- Data Processing Addendum (link): "Customers using hosted API enter by reference our DPA at [link]."
- Data Residency: "Customer selects region; we will not move stored data outside the region without consent."
- Encryption: "In-transit TLS; at-rest encryption optional via customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private."
- Logs & Telemetry: "Telemetry is retained X days by default (30) for Hosted; Dedicated/Private retention configured per contract."
- Subprocessors: "We maintain a subprocessors list; use the marketplace tile to link to the canonical list."

FALLBACK SCRIPTS (for listing reviewers / partner managers)
- If marketplace asks for a 'data export' clause and DPA not ready: "We provide standard DPA; send them to the legal intake doc and offer a trial while we finalize DPA."
- If reviewer flags 'no evidence of regional hosting': provide link to infra-runbook and offer a note: "Regional deployment available — contact solutions@redwood.com for validation."
- If billing mismatch: request marketplace SKU, attach internal mapping spreadsheet, and include contact for finance sync.

QA MATRIX (what to test before we push tile)
- Copy accuracy: locale spot-checks by native speaker or contractor.
- Links: DPA, SOC2, product docs resolve and are not behind auth.
- CTA routing: CTA A -> trial flow, CTA B -> region selector, CTA C -> sales intake form. Validate UTM tags.
- Visual assets: localized screenshots show date/time format and currency for the region.
- Privacy snippet test: make sure tile does not say "no data collection" if logs retained.

KNOWN EDGE CASES / OPEN QUESTIONS
- JP marketplace requires separate corporate disclosure text for AI services — legal to confirm exact phrasing (JIRA: GTMP-4821).
- Azure Marketplace sometimes truncates 4000-char long descriptions; find shortest canonical description fallback.
- Some partners request 'no third-party subprocessors' — need Legal guidance on when we can accept that.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES FOR ENGINEERING (short)
- Provide a single JSON payload per marketplace with fields: title, short_desc, long_desc, privacy_snippet, hero_image_url, localized_variants[]. (Ownership: Marketplace assets team)
- Tag each asset with a privacy_level: hosted | dedicated | private. Use this to render appropriate snippet.
- Expose a small admin UI to preview localized tile.

NEXT STEPS
- (Owners) Priya to run 2 locale spot-checks (fr, de) by 2026-03-12.
- (Legal) Leo to confirm JP disclosure phrasing and add to clause library by 2026-03-20.
- (Marketplace) Samir to create marketplace JSON payload template and upload to staging by 2026-03-18.

NOTES TO SELF / WORKING THOUGHTS
- Keep privacy blurbs short; marketplaces prefer short, scannable lines, not legal prose.
- For enterprise-targeted tiles, lead with "Private/VPC available" in hero line.
- Consider a small "privacy badge" icon set (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) for clarity.

REFERENCES
- Confluence: MKTP-LISTING-PRIVACY-2025 (linked above)
- Jira: GTMP-4821 (JP disclosure)
- PR: repo/marketplace-assets#PR98

-- end of runbook --
